'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Emerson Sklar LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emerson Sklar]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''CoT'''. Username '''Sklarface'''. Handwritten. LIGHT checked. Line 3 Planetary Shield → Planetary Shield Generator (V). Line 7 HFTMF → Heading For The Medical Frigate (not V). Line 11 Biggs, RL → Biggs Darklighter (V). Line 12 Chewie, Protector → Chewbacca, Protector. Line 18 written Luke Skywalker, RH (V) → Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (V). Line 20 Padmé → Padme Naberrie (V). Line 25 Wedge Antilles, LR (V) → Wedge Antilles, Legendary Rogue (V). Line 26 Wedge Antilles, RSL → Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader (not V). Line 27 Wes Janson, RV (V) → Wes Janson, Rogue Squadron Veteran (V). Line 29 H, C, + the Falcon → Han, Chewie, And The Falcon. Line 31 Obi-Wan In Radiant → Obi-Wan Kenobi In Radiant VII (V). Line 36 Antilles Man / Rebel Reinforcement → Antilles Maneuver & Rebel Reinforcements (V). Line 39 Houjix / OON → Houjix & Out Of Nowhere. Line 42 Sorry About The Mess / BP → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. Line 47 written Yub Yub Commander (V) → Yub Yub, Commander (V). Line 51 Commando Training / Klor Slug → Commando Training & K'lor'slug (V). Line 57 Strike Force → Strikeforce (V). Line 58 Coruscant: JCC → Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber. Line 59 Coruscant: Senate Landing P → Coruscant: Senate Landing Platform (V). Shield 12 YISYW → Your Insight Serves You Well (V).
